subject: homepage-imagery-2026-10-28
package: 28 Oct final sitting — homepage imagery (every section)
coverage: complete — one record per new homepage image
coverage_note: Every image in this PR's homepage pass, vendored under public/images/home28/ as webp (900px wide, quality 78). Licence + creator are each file's own live Wikimedia Commons metadata, verified 2026-10-28; nothing was scraped from Google Images and no AI image is passed off as a photo. Two files already had registry records and are re-recorded here for this use: city-karachi and city-islamabad/mycity-* (see subjects/karachi.json, subjects/islamabad.json, subjects/lahore.json). The Iqbal portrait (pers-iqbal) is a DIFFERENT Commons file from the UNVERIFIED bank portrait in subjects/allama-iqbal.json (thumb hash a/ac vs 6/65); the bank file is not reused anywhere in this PR. News thumbnails from the GNews API are NOT in this file: they are per-article publisher images supplied by the news API at render time, not vendored files. The Economy (§19) visual is a hand-drawn SVG chart from World Bank data, not a photo, so it has no record here. Flag images are untouched (sibling item F20).
